name: 51995-specdecode-8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B (target) + AngelSlim/Qwen3-8B_eagle3 (EAGLE3 draft head trained against that target); ~17 GB of bf16 weights together, both public and ungated.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 32 requests / 1800 s safety.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix buckets: exactly 27000 prompt tokens and exactly 256 output tokens (min = max on both), greedy (temperature 0.0), ignore_eos so every request runs to its 256-token cap, seed 51995.
purpose: A single-user document analysis assistant summarizing 27,000-token files into short answers, with draft-model acceleration on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine: commit 8e958902eee56ca5158728f1dd5a32246f0246f3 (v0.27.2rc0~12).
# Structured values are one-line JSON on purpose: the config reader is a flat `key: value` line
# reader that skips indented lines, so re-flowing one into a block mapping drops the key at rc=0.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B

speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "AngelSlim/Qwen3-8B_eagle3", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "draft_tensor_parallel_size": 1}

# Not the H100 default (FlashAttention), so it has to be written down. `TRITON_ATTN` is this
# engine's spelling of the member; the older `TRITON_ATTN_VLLM_V1` is not a member here and raises.
attention-backend: TRITON_ATTN

max-model-len: 32768
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Not a default -- the default is 1024. Do not delete as redundant.
max-num-seqs: 4

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85
enable-prefix-caching: false
enable-chunked-prefill: true
dtype: bfloat16
